tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my BOOM! profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in player's BOOM! profile: username, fitness level, lifetime score and number of games finished.

tools.name: get_my_game_history
tools.title: Get my game history
tools.description: List the signed-in player's most recent BOOM! game results, newest first, with room code, score and finish rank.

limit.description: How many recent games to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: get_my_workout_log
tools.title: Get my workout log
tools.description: List the exercises the signed-in player performed in BOOM! games, newest first, with reps, unit and whether the judge verified the form.

limit.description: How many exercise entries to return (1-100, default 20).

room_code.description: Optional room code to filter to a single game.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get the global leaderboard
tools.description: Get the BOOM! global leaderboard: top players ranked by lifetime score, with games finished.

limit.description: How many players to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: get_room_status
tools.title: Get game room status
tools.description: Look up a BOOM! game room by its 4-6 character room code and return its live status: phase, boss HP, pods and players with their scores.

room_code.description: The room code shown on the gym screen, e.g. 'AB12'.
